hypothesis_reviews.notes: The source requires k0 to be a field and M0 an additive commutative group with its Z-module structure. K is a field by its parameter declaration. M is a Z-submodule of the underlying additive group of the complex vector space V, so inherits addition, inverses and integer scalar multiplication. These are exactly the required structures, with no restriction on characteristic or lattice scaling.

conclusion_review.notes: E001 supplies a unital ring homomorphism G with G(f)(a tensor m)=a tensor f(m) for every f,a,m. D020 gives the same formula for the K-linear F(f).
